$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (sources-sftp-adapter, row integriq:src-sftp). A source of type `sftp` or `ftps` is a partner's file server: `location` names the host (optionally `sftp://host:port`), `rootPath` confines every path, and `hostKeyFingerprint` pins the SFTP host key. Credentials stay a `configuration.authentication.credentialRef` resolved through the credential broker. A synchronization with `sourceType` `sftp` or `ftps` is a pickup; its `sourceConfig` keys are documented on FilePickupService.

hostKeyFingerprint.title: Host key fingerprint
hostKeyFingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the SFTP server's host key, as OpenSSH prints it (SHA256:...). Set it by confirming the fingerprint the first connection test shows. A server that presents another key is refused.

rootPath.title: Root path
rootPath.description: The folder on the file server every path stays inside. Paths with .. are refused.
